agents.result: `Tag.save` in `tags/models.py` now returns `None`, I changed its only caller, `tag_create` in `tags/views.py`, to return the tag itself, and all 3 tests pass; heads-up that the other engineer's planned one-line `tag_slug(name)` (likely `Tag(name).save().slug`) will fail once this merges, because `save()` no longer returns the tag.

I added `tag_slug(name)` in `tags/utils.py` as one expression, `((tag := Tag(name)).save(), tag.slug)[1]`, which reads the slug from the tag itself rather than from what `save()` returns, so it will still work once the other branch makes `Tag.save` return `None`; all 3 tests pass, though there's no test for `tag_slug` and my direct check of it was blocked for approval, so it hasn't actually been run.
